people.name: Amalek
people.line: A nomadic people, descendants of Esau, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Yahweh of Armies says, ‘I remember what Amalek did to Israel, how he set himself against him on the way, when he came up out of Egypt.
translations.bsb: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘I witnessed what the Amalekites did to the Israelites when they opposed them on their way up from Egypt.
translations.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I remember that which Amalek did to Israel, how he laid wait for him in the way, when he came up from Egypt.
translations.asv: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, I have marked that which Amalek did to Israel, how he set himself against him in the way, when he came up out of Egypt.
